sheets.notes: Written report (not Tedds). Ridge beam referenced as 'designed under separate calculations' - no ridge beam calc included in package.

observations: Soil bearing mismatch: F1 calc uses qallow_Gross = 3.5 ksf and computes qmax = 2.505 ksf, which exceeds the drawing foundation note 3 value of 1500 PSF.
Footing reinforcement mismatch: calc 'No.4 bars at 6.0 in c/c bottom' vs drawings F1 '(3) #4 TOP, (3) #4 BOTTOM LONG. & #4 @18" O.C TRANS.' (size 15"x18", f'c 3000 psi and 3 in cover match).

Footing loads FDz1 = 1.5 kips/ft and FLz1 = 1.3 kips/ft (governing combination 1.0D + 1.0L, floor live) are far above the one-story roof loads (10 psf D, 20 psf Lr on ~8.75 ft run per rafter report) and the shear-wall top loads D = 25 lb/ft, Lr = 10 lb/ft - placeholder/inconsistent loads.
Shear walls use placeholder lateral loads W = 18 lbs and Eq = 40 lbs for every wall SW1-SW5 (and Lf = 20 lb/ft floor live load on a single-story ADU); no base-shear/wind derivation in package.
SW3 calc gives zero capacity (Vw = Vs = 0 kips, 'Error: divide by zero') but prints PASS - wall is effectively unverified.

SW4 sheet is internally inconsistent (h = 8 ft printed but h/b, deflection limits imply ~9.67 ft; Ft' 1380 and Fc' 417 lb/in2 and stresses imply 2x4 end posts while inputs are 2x6) - stale results pasted from another wall; also two 5 ft openings ignored (single 12 ft segment).
SW1 uses strength distribution method with no drift check (Tedds DESIGN WARNING printed); SW3 has no deflection section.
Wall height: calcs use h = 8 ft while S-2 wall framing notes state 9'-0" plate height.

Sheathing: calc side 2 is 5/8" gypsum wallboard with 0.120" nails at 4" (vs2 350 lb/ft added for wind vwc = 1415 lb/ft); drawing shear wall schedule specifies 7/16" OSB w/ 8d @ 4" edge / 12" field plus Stucco Ext. / 5/8" GWB Int. with no gypsum nailing specified. OSB 8d @ 4" matches.
Hold-downs: drawings call HDU2-SDS2.5 at all shear walls; calcs show net chord tension <= 0 (T = -0.011 to -0.033 kips) so no demand is derived; Tedds hole Dia 1 in assumed.
Anchor bolt callouts conflict: shear wall schedule 5/8" dia. x 7" vs foundation note 5/8"Ø x 10" @ 6'-0" O.C. max w/ 7" embed vs details 5/8"x8" @ 24" O.C. and 5/8" DIA.X6" EMBED @ 16"/32" O.C.
Seismic parameters: shear walls use SDS = 1 and Ie = 1.25, but rafter report states Risk Category II, Importance Factor 1.0, SDC D.

Rafter grade/ridge mismatch: rafter report and S-3 notes use 2x8 DF-L No. 2 @ 24" with (2) 2X10 ridge beam; S-8 details show '2X8 DF#1 RAFTER' and '2X8 RIDGE BEAM'. Ridge beam calc 'designed under separate calculations' is not in the package.
Edition mismatch: drawings cite 2025 CRC/CBC; Tedds shear wall and footing calcs use NDS2018, ASCE 7-16 and ACI318-14; only the rafter report uses 2025 CBC / ASCE 7-22 / NDS-2024 / SDPWS-2021.

S-0 general notes / structural criteria text is empty in the extraction; construction note 13 still references the UBC; S-sheets dated 2/2/2026 while architectural sheets dated 8/6/2026 and calcs 7/15/2026.
